intro: Denmark is a rich country whose companies make LEGO, wind turbines, medicines and run some of the world's biggest shipping lines.

chapters.title: Famous companies
text: LEGO, founded in 1932 in Billund, takes its name from the Danish 'leg godt', 'play well'. Novo Nordisk, maker of diabetes and weight-loss medicines, became one of Europe's most valuable companies, and Maersk is one of the largest container shipping companies in the world.

chapters.title: Wind and farms
text: Wind turbines, many made by Danish company Vestas, produce more than half of Denmark's electricity. Pork, dairy products and Carlsberg beer are major exports.

keyTerms.meaning: A ship that carries goods in large standard metal boxes.
